column4: a one-word donor package (test) must not be renamed as a dotted literal: the PACKAGE-literal rule (?<![\w.])test\. would rewrite prose ending a sentence with "test." and file names, so the dotted-literal rename applies only to donor packages that contain a dot; the one-word row still maps the package line and the imports

column4: a random lane whose close/reopen rates are equal leaves half of the regions closed and half of the operations refused as "PMem region is closed": a closed slot is reopened with probability 3/4 before any other operation, which keeps the refusal share at the invalid-argument and alias rate

column4: WSL2 shuts its VM down a few seconds after the last process and /tmp is lost with it: the per-family scratch directories (classes, library, dumps) live under /mnt/s so the donor and relocated dumps can be compared in a later invocation; the Java temporary files still go to the Linux /tmp (mmap of sparse 2 GiB files on drvfs is not the contract under test)
